items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: My brother took me to see Paul Whiteman and his big band.

ctx.x: And coming home from school one day, I passed the pawn shop. And I saw this beautiful horn in the window. I said, 'Oh, that's for me. I like that.'
